title: Armor
description: Canonical, app-owned armor record for the FFG Star Wars RPG. Ingested ONCE from OggDude's `armor` category (106 entries). Soak + Defense are the load-bearing combat fields; the rest is shared economics ($ref item-common). Replaces the runtime SWItems.normalizeArmor decode. NOTE: armor carries NO weapon-style Qualities (verified 0/106) — its special rules live in base_mods (free-text). Per-instance ATTACHMENTS are a separate deferred entity; armor here is the unmodified catalog base.
$comment: INGEST CONTRACT — numeric values arrive as STRINGS ('1','500','2') and coerce to int; Categories is list|scalar; Source is the scalar string OR Sources.Source is a list (both -> sources[]); Description carries [H3]/[P]/[BR]/[B] markup to decode; BaseMods.Mod carries the readable MiscDesc rules (Count>1 -> rank). Defense is absent on 14/106 (open-faced armor) -> omitted (consumer defaults 0). Soak is NOT required: oracle-confirmed RAW (consular p.47 / aor p.221) that Soak and Defense are independent and defensive items (personal energy fields, e.g. the Individual Field Disruptor: Defense 1, no Soak) grant Defense-only. The anyOf invariant enforces an armor grants AT LEAST ONE of {soak, defense>=1} — so a truly-empty armor still fails loud.

id.description: Stable app-owned id, slugged from Name; dedupe on collision.

description.description: Decoded from OggDude Description markup at ingest.

soak.description: Soak bonus the armor grants; coerced from string Soak.

defense.description: Defense the armor grants; coerced from string Defense. Omitted when OggDude has none (= 0).
defense.$comment: GENERAL-type grant. Per RAW (eote p.216 / fad p.216) Defense has three types — general / melee / ranged — and does NOT stack (best single rating applies). Catalog armor grants a single general value (verified 0/106 typed); the melee/ranged split + non-stacking are DERIVATION-time concerns (talents/shields/cover), NOT catalog data. See Docs/RULES_FOUNDATION_ITEMS.md.

type.description: Armor classification from OggDude Type (e.g. 'Light', 'Heavy'). Optional (47/106).

pool_mods.description: Extracted dice-pool modifiers at row level (R-DPS-1). Each entry traces back to its source mod object via from.

encumbrance_threshold_bonus.description: Bonus to the wearer's personal encumbrance threshold when worn (e.g. Pioneer Armor +3). Stated by the printed page.

threshold_bonus_requires.description: Minimum item state for the encumbrance_threshold_bonus to apply. 'worn' = only when state is worn; 'carried' = when state is worn or carried (not stowed). Adjudicated per-item from the printed page (C-LIM-3).
